concerns.text: The plan asserts that the entire pipeline (including inference on the full VRSBench and COCO validation splits, gradient‑based attribution on 200 hold‑out images, and statistical analysis) will complete within the free‑tier GitHub Actions CPU runner limits (2 CPU cores, ≤ 7 GB RAM, ≤ 6 h wall‑clock). Given the size of the datasets (≈10 k images) and the CPU‑only execution of a full‑size LocateAnything transformer, this runtime budget is unrealistically optimistic and likely infeasible. The claim conflicts with the compute‑constrained feasibility requirement of the project constitution.
